title: The Garden of Bellbird Bay
author: J. M. Dunmore
blurb: Oscar Whitlock, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
